name: Twin Paths Iteration Chain (v1-v6)
lineage: 6-step iteration chain, superseded by concept1_user_clean; earliest sketch archived as logos/archive/concept1_twin_paths_original.svg
signature: twin trunk paths of nodes with spiral node clusters
description: The original Concept 1 sketch-faithful mark: two trunk paths rising from root nodes, branching node-tree at top, air-spiral node clusters either side, Remu green with Manuka cream nodes and Wattle orange accents. Six documented revisions: v1 sketch twin trunks + spirals; v2 straight trunks to junctions with 30-degree outward branches; v3 removes crossing lines so the negative space between trunks becomes the two paths; v4 stripped-back clean single-line arms; v5 shared single base root with spirals wrapped into the arm structure; v6 corrected orientation (two roots at bottom, paths arc inward to a top apex) with open-arc spirals. Files: concept1_twin_paths_v2.svg through _v6.svg in the same folder; palette constant across all six.

name: Twin Paths User Design
lineage: recreation of the user's node-editor sketch; refined into concept1_user_clean
signature: Y-junction with long V-sweep arms
description: SVG recreation of the user's hand-placed node-editor sketch: two root nodes at base, straight trunks up to a Y junction, then two long arms sweeping outward in a V with node clusters. Remu/Manuka/Wattle brand palette with 'airtree / Pathfinders' Inter + Cormorant Garamond lockup.

name: Node Editor Canvas Export
lineage: raw export from the custom node editor built for this submission (website/node-editor.html); cleaned into concept1_user_clean
signature: 32 free-placed nodes and 26 edges on a 1700x1045 canvas
description: Raw 1700x1045 canvas export from the bespoke node editor the submission was built with (the rationale notes 'built using a custom node editor designed for this submission'). 32 cream nodes and 26 edge lines with no typography or background chrome - the designer's working canvas, preserved as the source of truth for the clean mark.

name: Twin Paths User Clean (Submitted Mark)
lineage: chosen submission per docs/rationale_submission.md (concept1_user_clean_remu submitted, wattle variant included); refined from concept1_user_design and the v1-v6 chain
signature: spine splitting into two 45-degree arms with a pentagon crown and central orange accent
description: The mark actually submitted to the Airtree Pathfinders competition: a single spine rises from a shared root into two arms diverging at 45 degrees, the gap between them reading as uncharted territory; five crown nodes form a closed pentagon with an orange accent at its centre, and two hex spiral clusters anchor the body. 500x560 lockup with 'airtree' Inter eyebrow and 'Pathfinders' Cormorant Garamond wordmark. Full 6-palette cross-product exported to logos/variants/concept1_user_clean_{manuka,night,remu,rimu,slate,wattle}.svg (manuka flips to dark nodes on cream with #CC4400 accent, wattle is dark nodes on orange).

name: Twin Paths Clean Node Cloud
lineage: denser re-rendition of the twin-paths figure after concept1_user_clean; 6 real palette recolors in logos/variants/twin_paths_clean_*.svg
signature: 60+ node twin-path cloud with orbit blobs on both sides of each axis
description: A denser, richer rendition of the twin-paths figure on a 500x520 crop: two diagonal node-cloud axes with dozens of orbit blobs, dotted-style edges and the standard Inter/Cormorant lockup. The night recolor introduces pale sage #B5C4B1 as a secondary node tone; six genuine palette recolors (manuka, night, remu, rimu, slate, wattle) live in logos/variants/.

name: Node Compass
lineage: concept 2 of 5; six palette-named copies in logos/variants/ are byte-identical (no recolor applied)
signature: eight-direction compass star built entirely from nodes around a central hub
description: Concept 2: a compass/star formed entirely of nodes radiating from a central hub - eight directions standing for eight paths to explore - with a sage #B5C4B1 counter-accent. Rejected in favour of the twin-paths figure but kept as a distinct radial-geometric direction.

name: Labyrinth Spiral (v1-v2)
lineage: v2 (concept3_labyrinth_v2.svg) rebuilds the spiral properly connected; six palette-named variant copies are byte-identical
signature: Archimedean spiral traced entirely in nodes, r = 14 + 14*turn
description: Concept 3: an Archimedean spiral (r = 14 + 14 per turn) traced entirely in nodes and connecting edges - a single continuous path spiralling outward as the pathfinder's journey. v1 placed nodes at regular angular intervals; v2 fixes connectivity so every node is linked and an orange entry node marks 'the way in'.

name: Airtree Extended Tree
lineage: concept 4 of 5; direct extension of the existing Airtree node-tree logo
signature: taller Airtree tree branching into a path network with a hidden P letterform
description: Concept 4: the existing Airtree node-tree logo grown taller and branched into a path network at the top, with a 'P' letterform hidden in the branch structure - the most on-brand, conservative direction of the five concepts.

name: Network Figure
lineage: concept 5 of 5
signature: human figure mid-stride abstracted entirely as nodes and edges
description: Concept 5: a human figure mid-stride, walking forward, abstracted entirely as nodes and edges - the pathfinder in motion. The most figurative and kinetic of the five concepts.

name: Pathfinders Icon V1 (Bold Blobs)
lineage: superseded by pathfinder_icon_v2; square 500x500 icon take on the twin-paths figure
signature: big bold node blobs with thin sketchy edges, single orange node at crown centre (250,95)
description: Square icon rendition of the twin-paths concept in Airtree's program-icon style: large bold Manuka blobs with thin subordinate sketchy edges, two trunks rising and branching outward with air-spiral clusters, and one orange crown-centre node. Six palette-named copies in logos/variants/ are byte-identical.

name: Pathfinders Icon V2 (Tight Split)
lineage: tighter rebuild of pathfinder_icon_v1 to match the existing Airtree blue program icon style
signature: single trunk splitting into two clear paths, side nodes staggered like the Airtree program icons
description: V2 tightens the icon: more compact and less wide, a single root and trunk splitting into two clear diverging paths of three nodes each with staggered side branches, closer to the existing Airtree program-icon language. Six palette-named copies in logos/variants/ are byte-identical.

name: Pathfinder V Dashed
lineage: mid-iteration of the final pentagon-crown figure (narrower 500x560 geometry, arms meet at y=432); solid-edge sibling is pathfinder_v_solid_orange
signature: dashed 8-5 edge strokes tracing both arms, orange crown tip nodes at (60,117)/(440,117)
description: Dashed-edge cut of the pathfinder figure: two arms of cream nodes traced with stroke-dasharray '8 5' paths - the dotted 'path' metaphor - with Wattle orange tip nodes at the crown. Exists with cream tips as pathfinder_v_dashed_cream.svg (all-cream, tips #F7F6E3).

name: Pathfinder V Solid
lineage: solid-edge sibling of pathfinder_v_dashed_orange; led directly into the tp07/final family
signature: solid 2.5px edge strokes, orange crown tip nodes
description: Solid-edge cut of the same narrower figure geometry - identical nodes with continuous 2.5px round-cap strokes instead of dashes, orange crown tips. pathfinder_v_solid_cream.svg is the all-cream tip variant; this solid+orange geometry is the direct ancestor of the tp07_remu_solid_orange/final exports.

name: TP-07 Gum Leaf Restored
lineage: reconstructed after original loss - exact rebuild of the user-approved tp07_gumleaf design whose SVG and generating code were destroyed in a cleanup; rebuilt from coordinate documentation as tp07_gumleaf_restored.svg
signature: two diagonal oval node-clouds like eucalyptus leaves hanging from one shared root, orange nodes at both leaf tips
description: The original approved design of the project: two diagonal gum-leaf node-clouds hanging from a single root, each leaf a central axis of shrinking nodes with orbit blobs on both sides, dashed edge strokes and orange tip nodes on an airy 440x500 Remu field. The lost original was reconstructed exactly from its documented coordinates (see the SVG header comment) after the file and its generator were accidentally deleted; the archive copy logos/archive/ holds earlier iteration history.

name: TP-07 Manuka
lineage: palette variant of the pentagon-crown pathfinder figure within the tp07 export set; darkened #CC4400 accent for contrast on cream; same design exported to submission_final/logos/variants/pathfinders_manuka.*
signature: pentagon-crown twin-arm figure inverted: dark green nodes on Manuka cream
description: The pentagon-crown pathfinder figure (spine from shared root, two 45-degree arms with spiral clusters, closed pentagon crown) in the light Manuka palette - dark Remu nodes on cream #F7F6E3 with a darkened #CC4400 crown accent for contrast. One of eight tp07 palette exports of the final figure.

name: TP-07 Night
lineage: palette variant of the pentagon-crown figure in the tp07 export set; near-black green field
signature: cream node figure with orange crown tips on a near-black #0E1210 field
description: The pentagon-crown pathfinder figure on a near-black night-green #0E1210 background - cream nodes, orange crown tips, highest-contrast member of the tp07 palette set. Exported to submission_final/logos/variants/pathfinders_night.*.

name: TP-07 Remu Dash Orange
lineage: dashed primary of the tp07 export set; identical design exported as the submission primary submission_final/logos/primary/pathfinders_remu_dashed_orange.* and as final_remu.svg
signature: dashed 8-5 arm strokes with orange crown tips on Remu - the dotted-path storytelling cut
description: The dashed primary rendition of the pentagon-crown figure: Remu green field, cream nodes, stroke-dasharray '8 5' arm strokes that read as dotted walking paths, and Wattle orange tips at the crown - the 'moment of discovery' accent. This exact design was exported as the competition primary (pathfinders_remu_dashed_orange.svg/png/eps).

name: TP-07 Remu Solid Cream
lineage: solid all-cream cut of the tp07 export set; exported as submission_final/logos/solid/pathfinders_remu_solid_cream.*
signature: two-colour solid figure - cream nodes and strokes only, no orange accent
description: The restrained two-colour cut of the pentagon-crown figure: every node and stroke in Manuka cream on Remu, solid 2.5px edges, crown tips left cream - the single-accent-free version for embroidery and one-colour reproduction.

name: TP-07 Remu Solid Orange
lineage: solid orange-tip cut of the tp07 export set; exported as submission_final/logos/solid/pathfinders_remu_solid_orange.*
signature: solid-edged figure whose only accent is the two orange crown tip nodes
description: Solid-edge pentagon-crown figure on Remu with cream nodes and the two crown tips flipped to Wattle orange #E8642A - the full-colour solid lockup pairing with the dashed primary.

name: TP-07 Rimu
lineage: palette variant of the pentagon-crown figure, rimu moss-green field
signature: cream figure with orange tips on rimu moss green #4A6741
description: Pentagon-crown figure on a rimu moss-green #4A6741 field - a softer, earthier alternative to the Remu primary, keeping cream nodes and orange crown tips. Named for the New Zealand rimu tree, continuing the native-timber palette naming.

name: TP-07 Slate
lineage: palette variant of the pentagon-crown figure, slate blue-grey field
signature: cream figure with orange tips on slate blue-grey #6B7F8B
description: Pentagon-crown figure on a slate #6B7F8B blue-grey field - the coolest, most muted member of the tp07 palette set, with cream nodes and orange crown tips.

name: TP-07 Wattle
lineage: palette variant of the pentagon-crown figure on the Airtree logo orange; pairs with concept1_user_clean_wattle as the alternate submission variant
signature: dark green nodes on Wattle orange #E8642A - the Airtree logo colourway
description: Pentagon-crown figure inverted onto the Airtree Wattle orange #E8642A field with dark Remu nodes and typography - the energetic colourway that directly echoes the existing Airtree logo's orange-background-plus-dark-mark language.

name: Final Manuka
lineage: final_ family manuka cut; re-exported to logos/variants/final_v_manuka.svg and submission_final/logos/variants/pathfinders_manuka.*
signature: inverted final figure: dark nodes on cream with #CC4400 accent
description: The final pentagon-crown figure in the light Manuka colourway - dark Remu nodes on cream with the darkened #CC4400 crown accent for contrast. Member of the 11-file final_ family that locked the submission design.

name: Final Night
lineage: final_ family night cut; re-exported to logos/variants/final_v_night.svg and submission_final/logos/variants/pathfinders_night.*
signature: cream figure, orange tips, on near-black #0E1210
description: The final figure on the near-black night-green field - maximum-contrast member of the final_ palette family.

name: Final Remu (Dash Orange)
lineage: primary cut of the final_ family on the re-cut 500x560 geometry (arm apex y=477, tips y=115); design-duplicate of tp07_remu_dash_orange and the submission primary pathfinders_remu_dashed_orange
signature: dashed 8-5 arm strokes, orange crown tips, Remu field
description: The locked primary: pentagon-crown twin-arm figure with dashed dotted-path strokes, cream nodes and orange crown tips on Remu green, with the 'airtree / Pathfinders' Inter + Cormorant lockup. Same design as tp07_remu_dash_orange at the final re-cut geometry.

name: Final Remu Orange Dash
lineage: earlier tighter-crop cut of the final_ family (arm apex y=450, tips y=63); superseded by final_remu.svg
signature: dashed strokes, orange tips, figure cropped 27px higher
description: Dashed + orange-tips rendition of the final figure on the earlier tighter-crop geometry - one of the four dash/solid x cream/orange-tip combos cut before the family was re-exported on the final 500x560 crop.

name: Final Remu Orange Solid
lineage: earlier tighter-crop cut (apex y=450); superseded by final_remu_solid_orange.svg
signature: solid strokes, orange tips, tighter crop
description: Solid-edge + orange-tip combo on the earlier tighter-crop geometry - the fourth combination of the initial final_ exploration before the re-cut to the tp07-matching crop.

name: Final Remu Solid
lineage: earlier tighter-crop all-cream cut (apex y=450); superseded by final_remu_solid_cream.svg; re-exported to logos/variants/final_v_remu_solid.svg
signature: solid strokes, all-cream, no orange accent
description: All-cream solid-edge rendition on the earlier tighter crop - the accent-free monochrome exploration of the final figure.

name: Final Remu Solid Cream
lineage: re-cut (apex y=477) matching the tp07 export set; exported as submission_final/logos/solid/pathfinders_remu_solid_cream.* and logos/variants/final_v_remu_solid.svg
signature: two-colour solid figure, all cream on Remu
description: The final re-cut of the all-cream solid figure - cream nodes and strokes only on Remu, matching the tp07 geometry exactly, shipped in the submission solids folder.

name: Final Remu Solid Orange
lineage: re-cut (apex y=477) matching tp07_remu_solid_orange; exported as submission_final/logos/solid/pathfinders_remu_solid_orange.* and logos/variants/final_v_remu_solid_orange.svg
signature: solid strokes with the two orange crown tips
description: Final re-cut of the solid full-colour figure - cream nodes with Wattle orange crown tips on Remu, differing from final_remu_solid_cream only in those two tip nodes.

name: Final Rimu

signature: cream figure, orange tips, on rimu moss green #4A6741
description: The final figure on the rimu moss-green field - the earthy alternate in the final_ palette family.

name: Final Slate
lineage: final_ family slate cut; re-exported to logos/variants/final_v_slate.svg and submission_final/logos/variants/pathfinders_slate.*
signature: cream figure, orange tips, on slate #6B7F8B
description: The final figure on the slate blue-grey field - the muted corporate alternate in the final_ palette family.

name: Final Wattle
lineage: final_ family wattle cut; re-exported to logos/variants/final_v_wattle.svg and submission_final/logos/variants/pathfinders_wattle.*
signature: dark green nodes on Wattle orange - the Airtree logo colourway
description: The final figure inverted onto the Airtree Wattle orange field with dark Remu nodes - the vivid brand-echo colourway closing out the final_ family.

name: Twin Paths Variant A - Hook Spirals
lineage: side exploration of the twin-paths figure; moved to logos/archive/tp_variantA_removed.svg after rejection; six palette-named copies in variants/ are byte-identical
signature: J-hook spirals curling off the outer arms
description: Twin-paths exploration where each air-spiral is simplified into a single J-hook curling off the outer arm - 'clean, minimal, deliberate' per its own header comment, on a tighter 400x440 crop with two root nodes.

name: Twin Paths Variant B - Teardrop Loops
lineage: side exploration of the twin-paths figure; moved to logos/archive/tp_variantB_removed.svg after rejection; six palette-named copies in variants/ are byte-identical
signature: teardrop/raindrop loops orbiting the arm nodes with tails pointing inward
description: Twin-paths exploration where each spiral becomes a teardrop loop orbiting the outer arm node, tail curled back inward - 'evokes a leaf or an eye' per its header comment. A stepping stone toward the leaf imagery later perfected in tp07_gumleaf.

name: Pathfinders Submission Website
lineage: polished cut of the working presentation site at project-root website/ (which also holds the interactive node-editor.html tools the logo was drawn with); served panels pull ../logos and ../docs from submission_final/
signature: fixed full-screen animated mycelium node-network canvas behind a giant Cormorant Garamond hero
description: The single-page submission site presenting the Pathfinders identity: Remu-green dark theme with a fixed animated node-network (mycelium.js) background, glassmorphic blurred fixed nav with Wattle CTA, an oversized clamp() Cormorant Garamond 'Pathfinders' hero, sage micro-label letter-spaced uppercase, concept gallery pulling the final_/final_v_ SVG exports, and the 150-word rationale. Inter + Cormorant Garamond via Google Fonts, matching the logo lockups exactly.
